description: Hand-authored ground truth for react-fetch synthetic fixture. Three TS/JSX fetch URL shapes each produce one HTTP_CALLS edge to the matching axum handler in the sibling server crate.
notes: The fixture is split into a `server/` Rust crate and a `web/` TS/JSX directory so matchAndLink's sameService filter (strip-2 directory comparison) classes the two as cross-service. The to_qn_suffix lands on `build_router` because today's matchAndLink uses RouteHandler.QualifiedName (route-declaring function), not the handler symbol — Phase D1 will rework that. The fetch_id_slot.tsx URL `/api/users/${id}` extracts to `/api/users` (trailing slash trimmed) and matchAndLink's path normalization pairs that against the axum route `/api/users/:id`.
